props.name: errorInfo
props.comment: React's captured component stack (dev-facing), or null before capture.

props.name: resetErrorBoundary
props.comment: Reset the boundary imperatively (in addition to the location auto-reset).

props.name: title
props.comment:
When provided, injects a `<Title>` portal to update the app-bar page title.
Pass `false` to explicitly suppress a title.
